the theory of boundary-initial value problems for Maxwell’ equations in dispersive media can be used to investigate electromagnetic pulse propagations in dispersive media.

the mathematical theory of electromagnetic pulse propagation in a dispersive medium can be developed by means of a boundaryinitial value problem of Maxwell's equations and that the mathematical theory is well suited for a numerical analysis.

the theory of boundary-initial value problems of Maxwell’s equations can be used to model electromagnetic pulse propagation in a bounded space-time domain and that, in particular, the mathematical theory of such problems can be illustrated by 1D-problem.

the mathematical theory of electromagnetic pulse propagation in a dispersive media.
